scope: SSH investigation and one user-authorized BBID sign-in; no firmware payload repair, daemon restart, reflash or account reset.

bbid.diagnosis: Initial boot trust acquisition ran before enrollment completed. Interactive sign-in registered trust and authenticated successfully without a service restart. The original user-visible failure was not reproduced; its exact rejection cannot be retrospectively proven.

appworld.diagnosis: Malformed QNX6 long-name checksum causes pathname lookup failure although directory enumeration and payload contents exist. A successful container CRC or fsck does not validate this lookup checksum.
appworld.artifactAttribution: Handset inode and payload timestamp match D:\tmp\2; inspected v4-neo-output has correct lookup checksums and a different inode. This is strong image attribution, not a complete partition hash comparison.

additionalFindings: BBM Python PPS adapter is repeatedly denied package authorization, error 22; distinct from successful native Settings login.
BlackBerry Protect kronos hostname cannot resolve after successful login; does not invalidate BBID success.
cleanup: All uploaded read-only diagnostic, credential-input and native capture helpers removed; no cleanup failures.
nextRepair: Use an OS autoloader whose embedded UFS long-name checksums are independently verified, or perform a separately scoped guarded live restoration. Correcting only a loose UFS does not repair an already-packed executable.
